persist the draft on the New ticket modal (unless canceled on purpose)

## Implementation

- Persisted the new ticket modal content in the project settings store, which is backed by `localStorage`.
- Clear the stored draft only after a successful ticket creation.
- Scoped modal remounting by project so drafts do not bleed across project switches.

## Validation Artifacts

- `artifacts/dashboard-draft-tests.txt`
- `artifacts/validate.txt`
